Courts · Hard

The Lawns.

Six open-air hard courts set among the trees — the everyday heart of the club for practice and play. Fast, true surfaces and priority booking mean a court is always within reach.

The everyday courts

Where the club comes to play.

The Lawns are where most of club life happens. Six fast, true hard courts mean you rarely wait — perfect for a quick hit before work, a coached session at lunch, or a long doubles set as the sun drops.

Surrounded by mature trees and open sky, they feel a world away from the city, even though you are minutes from it.

Practice

Sharpen every part of your game.

Beyond match play, the Lawns include a dedicated practice wall and ball machines you can book solo — so you can drill serves, returns and footwork on your own schedule.

  • Six fast, true hard courts
  • Practice wall & ball machines
  • Open-air play among the trees
  • Rarely a wait, 14-day priority booking
